payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the model incorporates visual contexts to enhance its understanding of named entities, suggesting that it inspects how image parts relate to words.

claims.text: The model uses visual contexts to disambiguate polysemous entities and improve predictions of named entities.
The modality attention module selectively amplifies relevant visual contexts, indicating inspection of how image parts relate to words.
The approach is designed to handle noisy user-generated data by leveraging both text and visual information for entity recognition.
